summary.text: Mike Brandenburg is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 28 (home city listed as Edgeley), serving from 1997 to 2002 and since 2005 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Brandenburg lists an occupation of Farmer.
It lists education as Edgeley High School.
It also lists North Dakota National Guard.
Family is listed as: Married (Lovice); 6 children; 18 grandchildren.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Brandenburg's standing committee assignments as Appropriations - Government Operations Division (vice chair) and Appropriations.
